dedupe_keys.name: vuelo fotogrametrico del ano 1988 de la carretera entre morella y zorita del maestrazgo

description: Vuelo fotogramétrico del año 1988 de la carretera entre Morella y Zorita del Maestrazgo is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Panchromatic photogrammetric flight scanned of the road between the villages of Morella and Zorita del Maestrazgo at a scale of 1:5.000, taken in July 1988 using the WILD RC-8 Ag 221 camera. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Photogrammetric flight of the road between the villages of Morella and Zorita del Maestrazgo corresponding to the year 1" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Fototeca Valenciana, ICV_CLAS:Ortofotos e Imágenes;Vuelos, Espanya, Photogrammetric flight, ICV_CLAS:Orthophotos and Images;Flights, Valencian Photo Library. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
